chapter.title: Start Here
subtitle: Eight short jobs. An hour, give or take.
A hammer, a bag, a bed, a warm meal and a way home.

quests.title: Open the Quest Book
quests.subtitle: It is in your bag, or press J.
description: Right-click the book in your inventory, or press J anywhere.
The chapter list runs down the left edge. That is the whole interface.

quests.title: Craft the Wide Hammer
quests.subtitle: Copper and sticks, not diamonds.
description: Make a Wide Hammer. It breaks a 3x3 face in one swing and never needs an upgrade to be useful.
The copper and sticks for it are already in your bag.

quests.title: Craft a Backpack
quests.subtitle: Twenty-seven slots that follow you.
description: Leather and string make a Backpack. Wear it in the back slot and right-click it anywhere to open it.

quests.title: Sleep One Night in a Bed
quests.subtitle: Three wool, three planks, one dawn.
description: Build a bed, put it down under a roof and sleep. Your spawn point moves to it.
Three wool of one colour and three planks is the whole recipe.

quests.title: Bake Eight Loaves of Bread
quests.subtitle: Three wheat each, no furnace needed.
description: Bake eight loaves so hunger stops being a reason to stop working.
The wheat is in your bag. Bread stacks, keeps, and never spoils.

quests.title: Place a Waystone at Home
quests.subtitle: Name it, and it is on your map forever.
description: Set a Waystone by your base and right-click to name it. Every Waystone you find afterwards can send you back to it.
Stone bricks and a copper ingot.

quests.title: Raise a Megatorch
quests.subtitle: No mobs spawn for 64 blocks around it.
description: Stand a Megatorch in the middle of your base. Nothing hostile spawns inside its radius, lit or not.
Torches, logs and copper. The copper blocks are already yours.

quests.title: Put Up a Chest or a Drawer
quests.subtitle: Drawers hold 32 stacks of one thing.
description: Make a chest to start. Storage Drawers are the better answer once you are mining: one item each, 32 stacks deep, labelled on the front.

rewards.title: Start Here is done
rewards.description: Next: the Create chapter. Andesite alloy is already in your bag, so quest one is a formality.
